text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen. It's a field packed with 
formidable rivals, including Symboli Kris 
S, the winner of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), 
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle was full of confidence after 
running a great race in the Kikuka Sho. 
She headed into the next race determined 
to steal the fans' eyes away from Symboli 
Kris S.
